title: Live reply from /v1/chat/sessions/:id/events
evidence: useConversation.ts reads event: message (history), event: chat (claude frames, managed) and event: runtime (registered host). Runtime path replayed by Gate B (H5) as a registered claude host sends it since Barkpark #25471: one turn_started, each text block as an item, so two text blocks land as two bubbles (the older host's turn_started per message still replays with --shape legacy). History rows claim the live bubbles instead of doubling them, as one row per turn: Barkpark stores every message's text joined, from either host (since #25471; before, only the last); Gate B drops and reconnects the stream after each turn and replays it (proof: the old one-bubble claim showed a third bubble of 329 characters). Seen live 2026-11-11: a message typed in the app (vite dev, real Barkpark, the Mac host) came back as a reply bubble and 'BarkBot replied'. Found there and fixed: a reloaded page showed no history, because Barkpark replays stored rows only after a Last-Event-ID and the first connect sent none; /api/chat/$id/events now asks from 0. Gate B does not cover that route (its stand-in stream replays without the header). A turn with a tool, live 2026-11-13 (npm run turn:live -- --tool, parity/live/tool.json): a file with a made-up code was put in the bot's folder, the bot read it and gave the code, and the working line named the tool. A page opened mid-reply shows no half reply and takes the stored row as the whole one (scripts/behaviour.mjs, 2 rules). A reload in the middle of a reply, live 2026-11-13 (npm run turn:live -- --midreload, parity/live/midreload.json): reloaded 6 s into a long reply, the reply finished on the fresh page once, and the counts held after one more reload. It needed Barkpark #26083 and #26064 (a long reply used to spend a 60-a-minute budget and restart) and the page asking for the stored rows when a half-heard turn ends (Barkpark sends a row only when a stream opens).
gate: npm run turn:live, -- --tool and -- --midreload (owner-run: needs the owner's Barkpark login and the enrolled Mac online; not in land or CI). Records: parity/live/turn.json, tool.json, midreload.json. In land: npm run behaviour (the mid-reply rules) and Gate B (H5).
